sentences.text:
Author: Jyotsna Rewal Dua Bench: Jyotsna Rewal Dua IN THE HIGH COURT OF HIMACHAL PRADESH AT SHIMLA Cr.MP(M) No.2873 of 2023 Decided on: 10th November, 2023 .
_________________________________________________________________ D a u l a t R a m . . . . P e t i t i o n e r V e r s u s S t a t e o f H . P . . . . R e s p o n d e n t _________________________________________________________________ Coram of Ms. Justice Jyotsna Rewal Dua, 1

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF HIMACHAL PRADESH AT SHIMLA
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: For the petitioner: Mr. Vinod Chauhan, Advocate.

For the respondent: Mr. Pranay Pratap Singh, Additional Advocate General with Mr. Sitharth Jalta,
Deputy Advocate General.

The petitioner prays for grant of regular bail in FIR No. 14 of 2023 dated 16.02.2023, registered under Section 376 of Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences Act, at police Station Renuka Ji, District Sirmour, H.P.
2.

entities.text: Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: At this stage, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the present petition with liberty Whether reporters of Local Papers may be allowed to see the judgment?
yes to file afresh at an appropriate stage in accordance with law, if need so arises.

Accordingly, the present petition is dismissed as withdrawn with leave and liberty as aforesaid.
.
The pending miscellaneous application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.

Jyotsna Rewal Dua of Judge November 10, 2023 R.Atal rt Daulat Ram vs State Of H.P on 10 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176046712/
